/--
Arbitrary value paired with a syntax that should be inspected when considering the value for reuse.
-/
structure SyntaxGuarded (α : Type) where
  /-- Syntax to be inspected for reuse. -/
  stx : Syntax
  /-- Potentially reusable value. -/
  val : α
